title: Open the curved master grid's sparse end so fillDensity 1..50 changes the picture (F-01)
change: In `SurfaceFill.buildObject` the master grid pitch is `masterPitch = Math.min(tonePitch, o6Pitch)` (surface-fill.js:5084-5120) with `o6Pitch = litMaxPitchPen()·penWidth·litCov` a density-free constant (1.512 mm) that beats `tonePitch = hatchSpacing(d)/TONE_SUBDIV` for every d ≤ 49.5. Make the sparse end follow density: e.g. `o6Pitch = litMaxPitchPen()·penWidth·litCov · max(1, tonePitch/o6Pitch0)` or blend `lineCountFor(d)` into `N` below the crossover, so N is strictly increasing from d=1 to 50 while d ≥ 50 stays byte-identical (fs-k2's BYTE-IDENTITY GUARD in scene3d-curved-density-floor.test.js pins 0-100 for `curvedMasterFloorPen` only — do not touch that function). Keep `toneLaw:'none'` (which already responds via `lineCountFor`) unchanged.
test: NEW `tests/unit/scene3d-curved-density-sparse-end.test.js` (loadVecturaRuntime, default sphere, Type=Hatch, toneLaw=ladder): RED today — `pathCount(d=1) === pathCount(d=25) === pathCount(d=50)`; GREEN — strictly increasing across 1/10/25/50 AND `JSON.stringify(paths at d=50)` byte-identical before/after (fixture pinned via a captured md5). Also assert the same on torus+contour and cone+spiral.
done_when: Sphere/torus/cone Ladder path counts strictly increase across d = 1/10/25/50; d=50 and d=220 output byte-identical to v1.3.98; `npm run test:unit` green incl. scene3d-curved-density-floor + scene3d-hatch-density-500; re-shot before-images differ at low but not at med.

title: Gate Fill Style off Types none / wireframe / contourSlice in isReachableOn (F-02)
change: Add a first clause to `SCENE_FILL_STYLES.isReachableOn` (context-bar.js:398): `if (mapper === 'none' || mapper === 'wireframe' || mapper === 'contourSlice') return false;` (before the faceted/default early-outs, mirroring the faceted off-axis rule), derived from the same source the engine uses — export scene3d.js:195 `SURFACE_FILL` (or a `Vectura.Scene3D.Params.SURFACE_FILL_MAPPERS` set) and test the membership rather than a string literal. Add a `NO_FILL_TYPE_NOTE` ('This Type draws no surface fill: Fill Style has no effect. Switch Type to Hatch, Crosshatch, Contour, Spiral or Stipple.') returned by `facetedNote`'s sibling and shown in `fillStyleControls` (scene3d-panel.js:592-608). Also skip the Density slider for those Types in the per-mapper roster (scene3d-panel.js:405-425) if it is listed there.
test: Extend `tests/integration/scene3d-fill-style-picker.test.js` describe 'mapper-aware reachability': RED — `isReachableOn('nibAngle','sphere',null,'wireframe') === true` today; GREEN — false for every roster id + `none`/`ladder` on all three Types, `groups('sphere',null,'wireframe')` marks every option disabled with the note, and hatch/crosshatch/contour/spiral/stipple results are byte-identical to the pre-change call (regression guard). Plus a unit assertion that `SURFACE_FILL` is the source (swapping it flips the verdict).
done_when: Picker greys all 48 on those Types with the note in the running app (screenshot); capture re-run records 144 more unreachable pairs per primitive and 0 shots for them; test:integration green.

title: Hide the 35 styles that collapse to rung-skipping on Spiral/Stipple (F-03, C-09..C-13)
change: Extend `CURVED_SPIRAL_STIPPLE_INERT` (context-bar.js:381-384) from the 9 mono laws to everything except `none`, `ladder`, `fineLadder`, `phaseFineLadder`: i.e. add the 12 ribbon laws (RIBBON_LAWS, surface-fill.js:72-77), the 6 bundle, 5 contField, 6 pen, 4 mk laws, `perceptualRamp`, `lozengeStipple`, `deepFillTSP`. Update the comment with the measurement (18-19 distinct pictures of 39; 432 bare-centreline shots). Do not touch the hatch/crosshatch/contour arm. Rename the constant's doc to say 'inert OR bare-centreline'.
test: Update the two picker tests 'curved (sphere) + spiral/stipple disables exactly the 9 measured mono laws' → 'disables all but none/ladder/fineLadder/phaseFineLadder' (stale assertion, contract changed) and keep 'curved (sphere) + hatch/crosshatch is unaffected' as the guard. Add a runtime RED/GREEN: `SurfaceFill.lastRibbonStats` after a sphere+spiral+taperedEnds build has `ribbonLaw && wallRings === 0` (proves the hide is justified; becomes the W-13 RED).
done_when: Picker on a sphere with Type=Spiral offers 4 fill styles (screenshot); re-capture shows `bareCentrelinesOnly` = 0 and unreachable grows by 35×2 per curved primitive; test:integration green.

title: Make the 9 mono laws and 5 contField laws read the density-derived pitch (F-04, F-19)
change: surface-fill-mono.js `makeCtx` (:104-107) sets `PMAX = max(FLOOR·1.6, o.litMaxPitch)` and never reads `o.count`/`o.masterPitch` that surface-fill.js:10197-10216 already passes. Scale the envelope: `PMAX = max(FLOOR·1.6, o.litMaxPitch · (o.masterPitch / REF_PITCH))` where `REF_PITCH` is the d=50 master pitch (so d=50 is byte-identical) and clamp to [FLOOR·1.6, 4·litMaxPitch]; thread the same factor into `GS` (:553) and `pitchFor` (:524). For contField, scale `cfOpenPitch` (surface-fill.js:4471) by the same factor. Keep `FLOOR` untouched (plot safety).
test: NEW `tests/unit/scene3d-mono-density-response.test.js`: for each of the 14 laws on a default sphere+hatch, RED — total ink identical at d=10/50/150; GREEN — strictly increasing ink across 10/50/150 with d=50 byte-identical to a pinned md5, generation < 1.5 s at 220, and coverage at 220 ≤ 0.6 of silhouette (ties to W-08).
done_when: The Density slider visibly changes each mono/contField law in the app (screenshot at 10 vs 150); test:unit green incl. scene3d-mono-substrate, scene3d-maze-tonal-range, scene3d-origin-spiral-tonal-range.

title: mkTick draws its ticks (F-05)
change: In `emitMarks` (surface-fill.js:5570-5944) the tick budget for `mkTick` (`chan:'count'`, `MK` :2402; capacity :2444 `1.02·R·floor(1.4·nCap)`; shape :2512-2521) resolves to ~0 ticks except at the highlight, leaving only the carrier rulings. Trace `nCap`/`solveAt` (:5771-5793) for the `tick` shape, make the count channel map coverage 0..1 → 0..nMax ticks per brick cell, and draw the ticks ACROSS the ruling as the text says; keep `MIN_MARK_MM` gate.
test: NEW `tests/unit/scene3d-mark-laws-draw.test.js` (shared by W-05/06/07): sphere+hatch+mkTick at d=50 — RED: paths < 100 with ink ≈ Ladder's skeleton; GREEN: ≥ 1,500 short segments (length ≤ 1.1·R), shadow-third tick count ≥ 3× lit-third, total ink within [0.7, 2]× Ladder's, no vertex outside r+0.01.
done_when: Sphere/torus/cone at med read as tick shading in the app (screenshots); the same picture character at both angles; test:unit green.

title: mkDashRamp dashes lie on the rulings at every density (F-06)
change: The inlined dissolution ramp at surface-fill.js:5772-5785 sizes `nn = min(ceil(L/P), floor(1.12·R/w))` with period `P = clamp(P0·R, MK_PMIN, MK_PMAX)`; at the med master pitch the row pitch `R` (:5705, `/ MK_ROW_COV`) is 3× the ruling pitch and the dash tile spans several rulings at its own angle. Tie the row lattice to the master rulings (row pitch = masterPitch, orientation `or:'along'` the ruling direction) and cap dash length at 2× masterPitch; the max-density picture (already correct) must stay byte-identical.
test: In `scene3d-mark-laws-draw.test.js`: sphere+hatch+mkDashRamp at d=50 — RED: > 10% of dash midpoints farther than 0.5·masterPitch from any master ruling (rulings taken from toneLaw=none at the same d); GREEN: ≤ 1%, max dash length ≤ 2·masterPitch, d=220 output byte-identical to pinned md5.
done_when: Med-density sphere/torus read as dashed rulings (screenshots), no floating tiles; test:unit green.

title: deepFillTSP fills the darks with a real traverse (F-07)
change: `tspAt` (surface-fill.js:8160-8181) displaces each ruling laterally with `TSP_PERIOD = 3.2 mm` and amplitude `max(0, (drawn − floorPitch)/2)` bounded by `endMM/2`; at med `drawn ≈ floorPitch` so amplitude ≈ 0 and only the golden-ratio phase spikes survive, while :4676-4678 halves coverage regardless. Gate the coverage halving on the traverse actually having amplitude (`amp > 0.5·pen`), and let the traverse amplitude come from the LOCAL gap `(localPitch − floorPitch)/2` after thinning, so the zig-zag spans the gap it opened; cap zig length at 3× pitch.
test: In `scene3d-mark-laws-draw.test.js`: sphere+hatch+deepFillTSP at d=50 — RED: shadow-third coverage < Ladder's and > 5% of segments longer than 3·masterPitch; GREEN: shadow-third coverage ≥ Ladder's, no segment > 3·masterPitch, lit-third byte-identical to Ladder.
done_when: Sphere/torus at med show a continuous zig-zag in the shadow and Ladder in the light (screenshots); test:unit green.

title: A saturation cap that binds: no style exceeds 0.6 silhouette coverage (F-08, F-21)
change: Four paths escape the plot floor: (1) `cfTightPitch` for contFieldTouch is `inkWidth()` (surface-fill.js:4469) — raise it to `PLOT_FLOOR_PEN·penWidth` like the others (the 'touch' look then comes from W-04's `fieldFloor`); (2) the crosshatch second family (`buildCrossFamily` :9598) is not included in the per-sample coverage cap, so bundleSubNib/mkDotScreen/mezzoRegion double up — apply the cap to the union of both families; (3) stipple dot count (:10380+) is not capped by area/dot-area at the floor pitch — cap it; (4) `mkDotScreen` `rMax = 0.58·R` (:2465-2481) — cap at 0.3·R. Add a shared `coverageOfSilhouette(paths, pen)` helper in tests/helpers (rasterise at 0.1 mm) so every item can assert the same bar.
test: NEW `tests/unit/scene3d-saturation-cap.test.js`: RED — sphere+crosshatch+contFieldTouch at d=50 coverage > 0.75 and sphere+stipple+ladder at d=220 coverage > 0.9; GREEN — every listed (Type, style) ≤ 0.6 at d=50 and d=220 on sphere and pyramid; Ladder hatch at d=50 byte-identical (guard).
done_when: None of the nine F-08 before-images re-shoots as a white disc; ink at max on sphere stipple < 12,000 mm; test:unit green incl. scene3d-fill-span-verdict and the ribbon suites.

title: Mono laws fill the torus far sheet seen through the hole (F-09)
change: The mono substrate (`MonoFill().emit`, called from surface-fill.js:10197-10216) receives one screen region; on the torus the visible surface is two disjoint screen regions (front tube + far inner wall through the hole) and the second is never passed. Build the region list from the same visibility the ruling laws use (the far-wall rulings survive self-occlusion via `torus-occlusion.js`/`hlr.js`), and run the substrate per region (or on the union polygon with a hole). Do not relax F7 (0 crossings of the near rim).
test: NEW `tests/unit/scene3d-mono-torus-far-sheet.test.js`: sample 200 points from the `none`-law rulings that project inside the hole (far wall); RED — for each mono law < 5% of those points are within 1.5·PMAX of any mono path; GREEN — ≥ 80%; and the F7 test (`scene3d-ribbon-f7-self-occlusion.test.js`) still reports 0 crossings.
done_when: Torus at med shows ink on the far inner wall for all 9 laws (screenshot a+b); F7 suite green; test:unit green.

title: originSpiral respects the plot floor on torus and cone (F-10)
change: `lawSpiral` (surface-fill-mono.js:2519) advances the spiral radius by a screen-space pitch from `C.pitchFor(I)` without the foreshortening term; on torus/cone the turns collapse under the pen toward the silhouette. Use `C.pitchLegible` (floor applied) for the radial step and skip a turn where the projected gap to the previous turn < FLOOR (as `lawDuty` does with `clamp(pitch, C.FLOOR, C.PMAX)` at :1141). Sphere must stay byte-identical.
test: Extend `tests/unit/scene3d-origin-spiral-tonal-range.test.js`: RED — on the default torus the minimum distance between consecutive turns (sampled every 2 mm along the spiral) < 0.5·pen for > 5% of samples; GREEN — ≥ PLOT_FLOOR_PEN·pen for 99%; sphere output md5 unchanged.
done_when: Torus a/b and cone re-shoot without solid white bands or moiré; sphere byte-identical; test:unit green.

title: Smooth bundleSubNib band edges (F-11)
change: bundleSubNib builds its solid band from N adjacent sub-nib passes whose ends are quantised to different samples, so the outline is serrated. Route it through the ribbon outline instead (it is a constant-weight band, so `ribbonize` with a flat width profile = passCount·subNib width — see `ribbonizeCore` :6239) or align all pass endpoints to the outermost pass's endpoint before emit.
test: NEW `tests/unit/scene3d-bundle-subnib-edges.test.js`: for each band, take the hull of its passes and measure the max deviation of pass endpoints from the hull's end cap — RED > 1 pen on torus hatch; GREEN ≤ 0.5 pen; ink within ±3%.
done_when: Torus/sphere/cone re-shoot with clean band edges at 800 px; test:unit green incl. ribbon suites.

title: Pole-safe hatch/crosshatch family: no pinch below the plot floor (F-12)
change: `angleFamily` (surface-fill.js:9000-9080) rules straight lines in the (a,b) chart square; every ruling with |da| ≥ WRAP_MIN_DA (0.2) ends at a = 0/1 which projects to one point. Add a pole guard in `emitAngledFamily` (:9332-9346): as a ruling approaches a = 0/1, stop it where the projected distance to the previously emitted ruling drops below `PLOT_FLOOR_PEN·pen` (the Jobard-Lefebvre occupancy hash at :9649-9680 already knows neighbours), and stagger which rulings continue (every other one) so the pole reads as a clean fan. Byte-identity guard for the torus (rim pinch) can be relaxed only there.
test: NEW `tests/unit/scene3d-hatch-pole-pinch.test.js`: sphere+hatch+none at d=50 — RED: within 3 mm of the pole, min projected spacing between adjacent ruling samples < 0.2·pen; GREEN: ≥ 0.5·pen everywhere; total path count within ±15% of before; scene3d-fill-even-spacing and scene3d-hatch-density-angle-stable stay green.
done_when: Sphere/cylinder/capsule/pyramid re-shoot with no ink pile at the pole/apex (screenshots at both angles); test:unit green.

title: Wire the width profile into the Spiral sink so ribbon laws render on spirals (F-03 follow-up)
change: The spiral path (surface-fill.js:10276-10379) builds `makeSink(back, null, spiralFam)` and only calls `softDrop`/`addPt`; `emitRun` (:7030-7034) ribbonizes only when `wCnt > 0`, and `noteW` is called only from `emitLineOnce` (:8590, :8603). Compute the same per-sample weight the ruling path computes (the width channel at :8603) for each spiral sample and call `sink.noteW` so `ribbonize` runs. Stipple stays monowidth (dots) and is exempt like the three-pen laws. Then un-hide the 12 ribbon laws on Spiral in `CURVED_SPIRAL_STIPPLE_INERT` (W-03).
test: NEW `tests/unit/scene3d-ribbon-spiral.test.js`: sphere+spiral+taperedEnds — RED (W-03's runtime assertion): `lastRibbonStats.wallRings === 0`; GREEN: wallRings > 0, every path `weightScale === 1`, zero vertices outside r+0.01 (protrusion guard from the handoff), `measureRingFillRate` ≥ 0.99 (read handoff finding 2 first).
done_when: Sphere+Spiral+Tapered Ends shows real width bands in the app (screenshot); expand-into-group is byte-faithful; ribbon suites green.

title: Stipple: screen-uniform dot placement, no pile-up at poles/apex, no clumps on superellipsoid (F-13)
change: The stipple path (surface-fill.js:10380+) lays hex dots on a chart-uniform (u,v) lattice, so dots pile where the chart compresses (sphere pole, pyramid apex, cylinder/capsule cap) and clump on the superellipsoid. Reject a dot whose screen distance to any accepted dot < 0.8·dotDiameter (Poisson-style dart with a spatial hash), and seed from a screen-uniform lattice as surface-fill-mono.js already does for its chart inverse (see the 'mono' family idea text). Keep the tone law's dot-skipping intact.
test: NEW `tests/unit/scene3d-stipple-spacing.test.js`: sphere+stipple+none at d=50 — RED: > 3% of dot pairs closer than 0.5·dotDiameter; GREEN: 0 pairs closer than 0.8·dotDiameter; superellipsoid: dot count per 1/9 screen cell varies ≤ 2× across cells with ≥ 30% visible area.
done_when: Re-shots show no solid disc at the pole/apex at med or max and an even field on the superellipsoid at both angles; test:unit green.

title: Calibrate the faceted density range (plane 4 lines at d=50) (F-14)
change: Faceted fill takes `hatchSpacing(d)` (scene3d.js:348-356, 7.5 mm at d=50) into `crossFamilies`/`hatchPolygon` via `faceHatchLines` (:1342-1361) and `spacingBand` (:1037), yet the default plane shows 4 lines (≈ 19 mm pitch by the plane's 351 mm perimeter). Find the scale between the mm spacing and the plane's world units (likely `uvCompression` or the plane's default size vs the projected-pitch compensation in scene3d-projected-pitch), and make the plane/box line count at d=50 match `extent / hatchSpacing(50)` ± 1. Do not change `hatchSpacing` itself (pinned byte-identical 0-100 by scene3d-hatch-density-rescale).
test: NEW `tests/unit/scene3d-faceted-density-calibration.test.js`: default plane+hatch+ladder — RED: fill line count at d=50 ≤ 5; GREEN: count within ±1 of `planeExtentAcrossRulings / hatchSpacing(50)`, d=1 count ≤ 0.6× d=50 count, d=220 byte-identical to pinned md5.
done_when: Plane and box at d=50 read as a hatched surface in the app (screenshots); scene3d-hatch-density-floor / rescale / projected-pitch stay green.

title: weightModulated / weightSmoothstep carry tone by weight at every density (F-15, C-03)
change: At d ≤ 50 both laws' ribbon width ≈ 1 pen (≈ No Tone) and only at 220 do they widen (ink ×2.6), i.e. the weight scale is derived from the density pitch rather than from tone. In the weight channel (surface-fill.js:8590 `weightModulated` branch and `WEIGHT_LAWS` :1964-1996) make the shadow weight a fixed multiple of pen (e.g. 1..4 pens by coverage) independent of masterPitch, clamped so the band never exceeds 0.8·pitch. Fold the pair with a `weightEase` param (C-03) in the same change if the roster edit is in scope; else leave the ids and only fix the scaling.
test: NEW `tests/unit/scene3d-weight-law-tone.test.js`: sphere+hatch+weightModulated at d=50 — RED: mean ribbon half-width (from `__hw`) in the shadow third < 1.2× the lit third; GREEN: ≥ 2.5×, shadow mean width ≥ 3 pens, lit ≤ 1.2 pens, and the ratio at d=220 within 10% of d=50's.
done_when: At d=50 the sphere reads shaded by line weight (screenshot); ribbon suites green.

title: mkScribble follows the rulings and is clipped to the silhouette (F-16)
change: The scribble branch of `emitMarks` (surface-fill.js:5823-5860) draws one triangle-wave per row on the `lat:'row'` lattice with `or:'along'` resolved in screen space, so on contour it fans radially and on the cone it is clipped to a stepped boundary (the row lattice's bounding cells, not the form region). Make the row lattice follow the master ruling family (row = ruling, wave along it) and clip each polyline to the form region like `emitRun` does.
test: In `scene3d-mark-laws-draw.test.js`: cone+hatch+mkScribble at d=50 — RED: > 2% of scribble vertices outside the cone's silhouette polygon (from the `none` mapper edges) or the covered area's boundary deviates from the silhouette by > 5 mm; GREEN: 0 vertices outside, covered-area boundary within 2 mm of the silhouette on the shadow side; torus+contour: each scribble row's mean direction within 20° of the local contour ruling.
done_when: Cone/torus/sphere re-shoot as ruling-following scribble inside the silhouette (screenshots); test:unit green.

title: Three-pen laws: butt-joined width steps, penStipple made honest (F-17, C-06)
change: The three-pen family keeps three real widths by design (handoff: exempt from ribbonize), but the pieces from `splitByWeight` (surface-fill.js:7030-7034 else-branch) are stroked with round caps so every width change bulges. Emit the split pieces with butt caps and a 15% overlap (same RIBBON_OVERLAP idea as the outline/fill seam) or extend the narrower piece under the wider one. Separately: `penStipple` draws no dots — either implement its dots (the `dot` mark class it claims) or drop it from the roster (docs/tone-laws/laws.json + `node scripts/build-tone-laws.js`) and from `FILL_STYLE_MARK_OF`.
test: NEW `tests/unit/scene3d-three-pen-joins.test.js`: rasterise sphere+hatch+penInterleave at 0.05 mm and measure the ink width across each junction — RED: max junction width > wider piece + 0.5 pen; GREEN: ≤ + 0.25 pen; `penStipple` either has ≥ 500 closed dot paths or is absent from `SCENE3D_TONE_LAWS.BY_ID` and the picker test's roster count drops to 47.
done_when: Torus/sphere three-pen rows re-shoot with clean width steps (screenshots); expand-scene3d-weight-to-strokes green.

title: Flow-field singularity control for etfKang / defectSplit on torus and cone (F-18)
change: `lawEtf` (surface-fill-mono.js:765) and `lawDefect` (:840) solve the direction field on the screen region; on the torus the field has a whorl at the bottom and a saddle on top, on the cone a ridge of arcs down the axis. Seed the field from the chart's principal direction (the mono substrate already has the chart inverse per the family text) and smooth across the axis; limit singularities to the region boundary.
test: Extend `tests/unit/scene3d-mono-substrate.test.js`: count field singularities (winding number of the direction field over a 2 mm grid) — RED: torus etfKang ≥ 3 interior singularities; GREEN: ≤ 2 and none inside the front tube's central third; cone: direction change across the axis ≤ 15°.
done_when: Torus/cone re-shoot without the whorl/ridge; sphere byte-identical; test:unit green.

title: dutyConst / turingStripe / mazeFill / voronoiWeb read a light→dark gradient (F-19)
change: `lawDuty` (surface-fill-mono.js:1354) maps duty only in the top of the coverage range so dashes appear as a thin lit sliver; `lawTuring` (:2339) and `lawMaze` (:2123) space by `C.PMAX` uniformly; `lawVoronoi` (:1492) already spans 2.5× (handoff: DONE) — verify it clears the bar and leave it. For the other three, drive the local pitch/duty from `C.pitchFor(I)` across the whole range (as voronoiWeb does with cell size) so the shadow third's coverage is ≥ 1.6× the lit third's.
test: NEW `tests/unit/scene3d-mono-tone-gradient.test.js`: sphere+hatch at d=50, rasterised coverage of the darkest vs lightest third (split by the lambert term the laws consume) — RED: ratio < 1.2 for dutyConst/turingStripe/mazeFill; GREEN: ≥ 1.6 for all three and ≥ 1.6 for voronoiWeb/endShorten (guards).
done_when: Sphere re-shoots show a visible light side for the three laws (screenshots); scene3d-maze-tonal-range green.

title: Type=Contour on faceted bodies: implement per-face contours or grey it (F-20)
change: On `solid` (buckyball) Type=Contour draws only edges (scene3d.js:2760 area — faceted contour has no planar implementation; box/plane get concentric rectangles via a different path). Either add per-face inset contours for solids using the same concentric-offset routine the box uses, or disable Contour in the Type picker for faceted primitives that lack it and show the existing `FACETED_OFF_AXIS_NOTE`.
test: Extend `tests/unit/scene3d-mapper-audit.test.js`: RED — default solid + contour produces the same path set as Type=none; GREEN — either ≥ 2 inset paths per visible face, or the mapper control marks Contour disabled for `solid`/`buckyball` with the note text (assert via `Vectura.Scene3D.Params` + the panel's mapper roster).
done_when: Solid + Contour either draws contours or is visibly greyed in the app (screenshot); test:unit green.

title: Collapse the ladder family behind `rungFineness` (C-01)
change: Roster edit: in docs/tone-laws/laws.json mark `fineLadder`, `phaseFineLadder`, `perceptualRamp` as presets of `ladder` with a new style param `rungFineness` (0..1, default 0) declared in `src/core/scene3d/params.js` (`clampStyleParam`) and surfaced as a slider in scene3d-panel.js beside D_TONELAW; in surface-fill.js the ladder rung count/phase-dither/gamma read the param (0 → today's ladder byte-identical). Keep the old ids resolving (params.js migration maps `fineLadder` → `ladder` + rungFineness 0.5 etc.) so saved .vectura files load unchanged. Regenerate scene3d-tone-laws.js with `node scripts/build-tone-laws.js`; update `FILL_STYLE_MARK_OF` and the picker roster count in tests.
test: NEW `tests/unit/scene3d-rung-fineness.test.js`: RED — `rungFineness` is not a style param; GREEN — `ladder` with rungFineness 0 is byte-identical to today's ladder, rungFineness 0.5 is byte-identical to today's fineLadder, 1 to perceptualRamp; a saved doc with `toneLaw:'fineLadder'` migrates to ladder+0.5 and renders identically.
done_when: One Ladder option with a slider in the picker (screenshot); the three old options gone from the list; all suites green; CHANGELOG/README updated per the doc contract.

title: Collapse the width family behind `edgeTaper` (+ optional nib angle) (C-02)
change: Same shape as W-22: `whiteBand`, `nibAngle`, `taperedEnds` become one law (`taperedEnds` id survives as the roster's own recommended default) with `edgeTaper` 0..1 (0 = whiteBand's hard ends, 1 = the smootherstep taper, byte-identical at 1) and `nibAngleDeg` (0 = off; > 0 applies nibAngle's |sin| modulation). `isophoteWidth` stays separate. Migration maps old ids to the param values.
test: NEW `tests/unit/scene3d-edge-taper.test.js`: GREEN — taperedEnds+edgeTaper 1 byte-identical to today's taperedEnds; edgeTaper 0 byte-identical to today's whiteBand; nibAngleDeg 45 byte-identical to today's nibAngle; migration of saved ids verified; ribbon suites green.
done_when: Picker shows one width-band option with two controls; screenshots of the three settings match the before-images; suites green.
